verdict.rationale: Metronome exposes a documented REST API (bearer-token auth, full OpenAPI spec) covering subscriptions, invoices, revenue data, and data warehouse export, which a custom agent could technically query for billing state. However, there is no evidence of a purpose-built agent/AI interface, natural-language query layer, or MCP server exposing MRR, delinquent accounts, or renewal status directly. Missing for 10: agent-facing query tools/MCP server, explicit MRR/delinquency/renewal endpoints, and any hands-on demonstration of an agent querying billing state.
